messages:
Maya: Quick sync We keep creeping scope. proposing a compact gating rule set to lock MVP and push non-blocking asks to Post-launch.
Owen: please share rules, want to avoid mid-sprint scope churn.
Maya: draft rules:
1) MVP (Launch): core gen API, auth, single-tenant routing, prompt templates.
2) Post-launch (0-6w): opt-in embeddings, basic telemetry page, perf tuning.
3) v1 (6-12w): SSO, multi-tenant routing, Dedicated infra, audit logs.
Decision rules: security/legal or signed-deal feature -> v1 gating review; perf regressions or critical bugs -> hold launch; anything else -> Post-launch.
Ravi: engineering note: SSO + multi-tenant are coupled (3-5w). moving to v1 frees time. embeddings behind flag is fine.
Hannah: design: can do flag UX + skeleton telemetry for launch. full analytics for v1.
Owen: operational ask: add fallback plan if Post-launch slips (e.g., temporarily rate-limit new tenants).
Maya: agreed. decision: aim to finalize by COB. react :thumbsup: to approve or post blockers.
Ravi: :thumbsup: will add feature-flag checklist.
Hannah: :thumbsup:.
product-ops-bot: Created note https://company.docs/milestones/2145003210 labels: "mvp-lock", "gating"
Maya: Thanks all I'll collate and update the roadmap.
